fonts: Google Fonts: Google Sans Flex, Roboto
assets: index.html, careers.html, demo.html, job.html inline SVG

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (cool light grey, near-black in dark), one clear step below surface in both themes so white panels stand out. Also the fill of fields and recessed panels that sit on a surface.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Tiles, cards, panels and sheets that sit on bg.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Quiet fill: hover on rows and quiet buttons, the search bar, the file icon square, the segmented control track.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text on bg, surface and tint. Also the fill of the dark pill buttons. Neutral black on purpose: never a purple or navy near-black.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on an ink fill (the dark pill buttons, a chosen Yes/No).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg, surface and tint: descriptions, meta lines, labels, inactive tabs.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Solid hairlines: the rule above the copyright, the faded dividers between list rows.

tokens.name: wash
tokens.usage: Ink at 3%: the outer tray of a two-layer form card, the copy capsule's fill.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Ink at 6%: the faded dividers between cards and sections, the 1px ring around rows and panels.

tokens.name: tile-line
tokens.usage: Ink at 8%: the 1.5px masked edge of tiles, sheets and panels, tag outlines, the line inside a panel.

tokens.name: field-line
tokens.usage: Ink at 16%: the 1.5px outline of outlined inputs, Yes/No pills and the outline button.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The site blue: links, the accent word in section headings, the active item in a list, focus rings, progress, the 95% stat. Text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Blue fill behind primary content: pixel icon tiles, the done-state circle.

tokens.name: on-primary-soft
tokens.usage: Text on primary-soft.

tokens.name: primary-inv
tokens.usage: The other theme's blue: a pixel glyph's hover colour on the dark pill buttons, where primary would not read.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Primary at 20%: the 3px glow around a focused field (with a solid primary border).

tokens.name: err
tokens.usage: Error text and the border of an invalid field, on surface and bg.

tokens.name: chip-green
tokens.usage: Success chip fill: Interview, Applied (done), Filled.

tokens.name: chip-green-ink
tokens.usage: Text and ticks on chip-green.

tokens.name: chip-blue
tokens.usage: Neutral status chip fill: Applied, New.

tokens.name: chip-blue-ink
tokens.usage: Text on chip-blue.

tokens.name: chip-purple
tokens.usage: Chip fill for things Bet did or noticed: Viewed, Drafted by Bet.

tokens.name: chip-purple-ink
tokens.usage: Text on chip-purple.

tokens.name: chip-amber
tokens.usage: Intentional addition for products: warning chip fill (needs review, closing soon). Not used on the marketing site.

tokens.name: chip-amber-ink
tokens.usage: Intentional addition: text on chip-amber.

tokens.name: chip-red
tokens.usage: Intentional addition for products: problem chip fill (closed posting, failed). Always paired with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: chip-red-ink
tokens.usage: Intentional addition: text on chip-red.

tokens.name: hero-base
tokens.usage: Ground of the colour field (hero, sign-off tile, phone panel). Lavender white in light, the page black in dark.

tokens.name: hero-a
tokens.usage: Colour field blob, top left (blue).

tokens.name: hero-b
tokens.usage: Colour field blob, top right (lilac).

tokens.name: hero-c
tokens.usage: Colour field blob, bottom left (lavender).

tokens.name: hero-d
tokens.usage: Colour field blob, bottom right (periwinkle).

tokens.name: hero-ink
tokens.usage: Text on the colour field. The same neutral as ink.

tokens.name: hero-accent
tokens.usage: The one purple for words: the accent word of the hero headline ("easy.") and of a line on the colour field. Never a fill, never a background.

tokens.name: glass-a
tokens.usage: Liquid glass tint, top of the gradient.

tokens.name: glass-b
tokens.usage: Liquid glass tint, bottom of the gradient.

tokens.name: glass-rim
tokens.usage: Specular rim light on glass, top left.

tokens.name: glass-rim-soft
tokens.usage: Softer rim light, bottom right, and the sheen across the upper half.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: The 1px hairline that defines glass against the page.

tokens.name: glass-shadow
tokens.usage: Shadow colour under glass.

tokens.name: glass-lens
tokens.usage: The brighter drop of glass behind the current tab (the lens), and glass on hover.

tokens.name: glass-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for a tab or round button inside glass.

tokens.name: px-dot
tokens.usage: The 1px dots of the pixel bands between sections.

tokens.name: octo
tokens.usage: Bet the octopus: body. Mascot colours never change with the theme.

tokens.name: octo-shade
tokens.usage: Bet: the shaded right side.

tokens.name: octo-shine
tokens.usage: Bet: the highlight on the top left of the head.

tokens.name: octo-cheek
tokens.usage: Bet: cheeks.

tokens.name: octo-eye
tokens.usage: Bet: pupils and the closed-eye line. Mascot only; this near-black purple is banned everywhere else.

tokens.name: octo-glint
tokens.usage: Bet: the white of the eyes.

tokens.name: fish
tokens.usage: Eco the fish: body. Crew colours never change with the theme.

tokens.name: fish-shade
tokens.usage: Eco: the tail and the shaded underside.

tokens.name: fish-shine
tokens.usage: Eco: the highlight along the back.

tokens.name: crab
tokens.usage: Tango the crab: body and claws.

tokens.name: crab-shade
tokens.usage: Tango: the shaded right side and the legs.

tokens.name: crab-shine
tokens.usage: Tango: the highlight on the shell.

tokens.name: crew-bloop
tokens.usage: Bloop's name in text (the chip-purple ink): a chat line's speaker label, the crew strip. 4.5:1 or better on bg, surface and tint.

tokens.name: crew-eco
tokens.usage: Eco's name in text. 4.5:1 or better on bg, surface and tint.

tokens.name: crew-tango
tokens.usage: Tango's name in text. 4.5:1 or better on bg, surface and tint.

tokens.name: player
tokens.usage: Behind a video before its first frame paints.

families.display: "Google Sans Flex", "Google Sans", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: One per page, the hero headline. clamp(2.4rem, 7.6vw, 4.9rem). Its accent word is 700 in hero-accent.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page title on pages without a hero. clamp(2.6rem, 5vw, 4rem). Accent word in primary.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: A single big number, in primary, tabular figures. clamp(4rem, 7vw, 6.4rem).

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Bento and panel headlines. clamp(1.8rem, 3.4vw, 3.1rem). A second line in primary at 700.

styles.name: section
styles.sample: The future of applying to jobs
styles.usage: Section headings. clamp(1.9rem, 3.4vw, 2.75rem); 1.75rem on phones. Accent words in primary.

styles.name: step
styles.usage: Large step titles in a scrolling story. clamp(1.6rem, 2.5vw, 2.25rem).

styles.name: title-xl
styles.usage: Panel title one step under headline. clamp(1.7rem, 2.8vw, 2.4rem).

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: A call-to-action line. clamp(1.45rem, 2.1vw, 1.9rem).

styles.name: title-md
styles.usage: Card and group titles. 1.25rem on phones.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Tile titles, section titles inside a panel.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: List row titles (a role, a job).

styles.name: question
styles.usage: Accordion questions, dnav items.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The lowercase wordmark beside the octopus.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small label above a title, in muted.

styles.name: pill
styles.usage: Feature pills and the copy capsule.

styles.name: app-title
styles.usage: Product scale: the job title on a job card.

styles.name: app-heading
styles.usage: Product scale: a screen or panel heading.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Bet finds the jobs, fills the forms and keeps track.
styles.usage: Lead paragraph under a heading, in muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Import your resume and Bet picks 20 jobs a day.
styles.usage: Default text. Long descriptions use line-height 1.7.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Tile descriptions, secondary paragraphs.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Text on the main pill button.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Tabs, small buttons, the Apply pill. The current tab is 600.

styles.name: app-body
styles.sample: You'll build the systems that move money.
styles.usage: Product scale: body text in cards and panels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines under a title, in muted, with the pay in ink.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Errors, field help, detail labels.

styles.name: app-meta
styles.usage: Product scale: meta under a row title, chips.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Copyright line, tiny meta.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between a tab row's items, the top bar's inner gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Top bar padding, title to line in a tight pair.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Label to field, glyph to text, bubble padding top and bottom.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Chip and option gaps, small button padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Button gap, list gap between cards on phones, the fixed top bar's top on phones.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Label to title in a panel head, row padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Bento gap, the top bar's distance from the top, phone side gutter.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Pill padding, hero content gap.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Desktop side gutter minimum, footer bottom bar padding.

tokens.name: space-22
tokens.usage: Gap inside a tile, padding at the start of the main pill button.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Form card tray padding, gap between form rows.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Gap between a card's head and its media, contact row.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Form panel padding, tile padding at full width.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a list, posting padding.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Panel padding at full width, space under a card before its divider.

tokens.name: space-56
tokens.usage: Gap between a sticky side column and the content.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Footer link row bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-80
tokens.usage: Footer top padding.

tokens.name: space-112
tokens.usage: Section padding at the top of a page without a hero: clamp(112px, 15vh, 148px).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button, tab, chip, tag, the top bar, inputs shaped as a search pill.

tokens.name: radius-tray
tokens.usage: The outer tray of a two-layer form card.

tokens.name: radius-app-card
tokens.usage: Product scale: a full job card in the feed.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: A sheet that slides over the hero, the content sheet on a page. 22px on phones.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Bento tiles, raised panels, speech bubbles, the footer panel. 20px on phones.

tokens.name: radius-list
tokens.usage: Product scale: a grouped list of rows, the next-step card.

tokens.name: radius-row
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a list row, the fit block in a job card.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Inner form panel, accordion items, video frames, recessed panels, drop zones, menus.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Inputs, feed rows, small video frames on phones.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Compact fields, the file icon square, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Focus outline on inline links.

shadow.note: Neutral shadows only, built on rgb 20 20 20. No purple or navy tint.

tokens.name: shadow-cta
tokens.usage: The main dark pill button at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-cta-hover
tokens.usage: The main dark pill button on hover (with a 1px lift).

tokens.name: shadow-pill
tokens.usage: Small dark pills and circles: the top bar button, the copy circle, a row's Apply pill on hover.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: The glass top bar: rim lights, hairline edge and a two-layer drop.

tokens.name: shadow-glass-sm
tokens.usage: Glass buttons and pills (ghost button, feature pills, Apply pills, menus, toasts).

tokens.name: shadow-glass-hover
tokens.usage: Glass buttons and pills on hover.

tokens.name: shadow-lens
tokens.usage: The lens behind the current tab.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: The white form panel inside a tray, dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: A big content panel standing on the page (the job posting panel).

tokens.name: shadow-media
tokens.usage: Video and screenshot frames.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Above the top edge only, so a sheet lifts off what is under it.

tokens.name: shadow-row
tokens.usage: A small surface row on bg (a job in a feed).

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Product scale: a job card.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: A card being dragged. Fade it in as a pseudo-element's opacity, never animate box-shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-light-btn
tokens.usage: The white Upload pill and other light buttons on bg.

weight.note: Two weights carry the whole system. Large display headings stay at 500; titles at title-weight.

tokens.name: title-weight
tokens.usage: Card, tile, row and panel titles, the wordmark, the bet. bubble, accent words. Never on hero, display, headline, section or step headings (500).

tokens.name: ui-weight
tokens.usage: Buttons, tabs, labels, names, chips, large display headings.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: The widest content band: hero, sheets, bento, footer. min(1240px, 100vw - 40px).

tokens.name: column
tokens.usage: A single reading column of cards.

tokens.name: form-width
tokens.usage: Form cards and the FAQ list.

tokens.name: side-gutter
tokens.usage: Inner side padding of a band at full width: clamp(20px, 4vw, 50px).

tokens.name: sticky-top
tokens.usage: Where sticky columns stop, just under the floating top bar. Also scroll-margin-top.

tokens.name: topbar-h
tokens.usage: Height of tabs, the brand and buttons inside the top bar (36px on phones).

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Longest line of running text (posting and FAQ answers). Legal text 68ch.
